2. The respondent No. 1 as plaintiff instituted aforesaid suit for declaration of his title in 'Ka' scheduled land and recovery of khas Possession and for further declaration that the deed as described in schedule 'Kha' of the plaint is illegal, void and the same is not binding upon the plaintiff. His case, in short, Was that the suit land as described in schedule 'Ka' of the plaint originally belonged to Shyamoli Housing Ltd. who got the same by virtue of a deed dated 24.05.1980 from Junu Bepari Shyamoli Housing Ltd. transferred the said land to Jamal Uddin by deed dated 22.02.1986 Said Jamal Uddin, after so purchase, mutated his name in the khatian and had been possessing the same paying rent to the Government. Thereafter, Jamal Uddin transferred the same to the plaintiff by a deed dated 23.03.2005. This plaintiff took over possession of the suit land and mutated his name in the khatian and paid rent. On 15.03.2006, the defendant dispossessed the plaintiff from the suit land hence is the suit. 

 3. The defendant No. 1 in his written statement contended that Shyamoli Housing Ltd. sold the suit to this defendant petitioner by a deed dated 19.07.1992. This defendant took over possession of the suit land. He also mutated his name in the khatian and paid rent to the Government.
